metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugin collection with 8 specialized plugins. Codex reads the same `.claude-plugin/` manifests natively (manifest fallback, no generated layer).

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Hooks only: Python auto-format on Write/Edit, cross-platform terminal notifications, and a per-prompt behavioral block (`prompt_inject.sh`, shared Claude + Codex). The block is fixed; two pointers are conditional — `.llmwiki/insight/` when a knowledge root resolves in cwd, and a one-line `[council]` delegation reminder when a second-model CLI (codex / agy) is on PATH (Claude-only). Work guidelines live in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Development lifecycle in one bundle. GitHub workflow — commit-and-push, decompose-issue, resolve-issue, release, cr-fix (unified CodeRabbit + ChatGPT-Codex review loop with autonomous apply/defer/skip judgment and rate-limit fallback), post-merge (branch cleanup + config/wiki integration with a mandatory wiki-lore ingest), state-tracker (spec/issue/PR aggregate over .claude/state/spec.json). Project setup — new (first-day bootstrap: interview, .claude/ scaffold, CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md with Codex reviewer guidelines, gh repo create) and wiring (14-axis harness diagnostic for an existing repo, read-only until approved). Playwright E2E harness — e2e-setup, e2e-author, e2e-debug wrap Playwright's planner/generator/healer agents; never overwrite an existing playwright.config and degrade gracefully without Playwright.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Documents people and agents read, plus publishing them elsewhere. Project docs — readme / changelog / deploy-doc / moc commands backed by the doc-guides reference cards. Agent-facing authoring — write-rules (CLAUDE.md + .claude/rules), interview-methodology (requirements interview, grill-me stress test, TCREI reusable-prompt output), and the skill-forge family (skill-forge authoring, skill-audit single-skill diagnosis, skill-fleet-review repository-wide sweep). Publishing — translate-web-article (web page to Korean markdown) and gws-sync (one-way local to Google Drive sync behind an approval gate).

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: Research and search. research-orchestrator routes a query to five scout agents (github / hf / web / docs / paper) in parallel and synthesis-scout dedups, trust-ranks, and writes the report (exa MCP first, WebSearch fallback, brightdata tier-3, insane-search tier-4). ask and generate-llmstxt query a GitHub repository through the DeepWiki MCP. paper-search searches and downloads papers from arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and five more sources through the bundled paper-search MCP server (.mcp.json, Docker). Non-code/ML topics go to the sibling /deep-research.

plugins.name: ml
plugins.description: ML / multimodal / CV development: ml-dev-principles (working discipline incl. GPU parallel patterns), gradio-cv-app (Gradio computer-vision demo apps), cv-notebook (CV experiment notebooks with an interactive ipywidgets exploration mode), edit-notebook (safe .ipynb editing through NotebookEdit).

plugins.name: wiki
plugins.description: Memory and lore. Karpathy LLM-Wiki 3-layer under the neutral .llmwiki/ root (insight + wiki + raw): bootstrap-wiki, ingest-finding (reversible diff-log + cross-page update), lint-wiki (four wiki-rot modes), plaud-note-taking (PLAUD Whisper transcript correction into .llmwiki/raw/transcripts/), plus five hooks — stale-page hint, post-commit ingest hint, session-start lint hint, Stop-time capture of ingest candidates, and the next session's drain. mem0 fleet operations — fleet-scan (per-app noise / fragmentation / config posture, read-only) and cleanup (backup-then-delete behind a dry-run default and a per-app confirmation gate).

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Claude-only (do not install into Codex). Cross-vendor model council. codex (GPT), agy (Gemini), and a Claude Opus seat answer independently, surface follow-up questions to the user, then rebut each other before the chair synthesizes. Seat models live in a weekly-TTL registry at ~/.claude/council-models.json. Claude-only; excluded from Codex sync.

plugins.name: codex-image
plugins.description: Claude-only (do not install into Codex). Generate or edit images from Claude Code by delegating to Codex CLI image generation (ChatGPT OAuth, no OpenAI API key). Claude-only bridge; excluded from Codex sync.
